summary.zh: 查询企业工商与风险信息
summary.en: Look up company registry and risk data

description.zh: 按企业名称查询工商登记、股东、对外投资、司法与经营风险信息。适合合作前做背景核查。首次连接跳转天眼查账号登录并授权。
description.en: Look up registration details, shareholders, investments, litigation, and operating risk for a company. Useful for background checks before a partnership. Tianyancha sign-in and consent happen in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接跳转天眼查登录并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Tianyancha and authorize on first connect
